result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears largely functional and well-structured. One notable inconsistency was found related to the heart/favorite icon styling.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white background circle, while the heart icon on the pizza card below has a dark/black background circle. This inconsistency in icon container styling looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the pizza card reads '-0%', which is a meaningless discount value and likely a rendering or data error.
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount logic so a valid percentage is displayed, or hide the badge when the discount is zero.
